name: Ecomm Design

sources.title: ecomm.design - Submit Your eCommerce Store (returned 403 to automated fetch; copy verified via search index)
ecomm.design - About ('if you want to submit an online shop to our gallery, please use this form')
ecomm.design - eCommerce Website Design Gallery (4,000+ stores by platform/category/tech)

requirements: STRICT eligibility: only actual online shops/e-commerce stores are accepted - the submit page explicitly says 'please don't submit portfolio / studio websites. We can only accept online shops'
The store should be design-worthy: the gallery curates 'top eCommerce website designs' browsable by platform, category, technology, and traffic
A SaaS marketing site or agency portfolio does not qualify - the submitter's own store or a client's live storefront does
preparation: URL of a live e-commerce store (working checkout, real products)
Store name and a short pitch
Optional detail that helps the gallery entry: ecommerce platform (Shopify, BigCommerce, custom...), category, notable tech
workflow: Open https://ecomm.design/submit/ in a real browser (the page embeds a 'Fill out my online form' widget and blocked automated fetches)
Complete the form with the store URL and details
Submit and wait - acceptance is curated; no review SLA is published
If featured, the store joins the public gallery browsable by platform/category/tech
watchFor: Do not submit non-store sites - the eligibility bar is stated bluntly and rejections for portfolios/studios are explicit
The form is an embedded third-party widget; a script-less fetch shows only the eligibility warning
ecomm.design also sells agency services (store audits, migrations, setup) - those pages are unrelated to the free gallery submission
No paid submission tier is advertised for the gallery itself
countsAsLive: The store appears as a public entry in the ecomm.design gallery with its own detail page (platform/category/tech attributes)
unknowns: Whether the outbound store link is dofollow on live entries (one third-party source claims dofollow)
Whether account creation is needed or the form is anonymous
